summary: The project whole and the evidence-grounded triage stance are clear enough to explain the users, operating reality, boundaries, major failure modes, and intended first Task. However, a fresh Agent still cannot responsibly execute TASK-001 without inventing the contract artifact, test harness, and part of the candidate policy. The Work Map also contradicts its stated sequence because every later Task is dependency-free. This is a repairable handoff gap, not a blocked project.

gaps.gap: TASK-001 does not locate the context it explicitly requires.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Its done conditions require executable program-role and art-role cases derived from sample-project, and its boundary says to follow the capability dossier, but reads contains only .loom/PROJECT.md. `loom context --task TASK-001` therefore provides neither the dossier body nor the raw BACKLOG.md and GIT_LOG.txt inputs. A restarted Agent would have to rediscover task-critical files outside the Task contract.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Add .loom/capabilities/evidence-grounded-triage.md, sample-project/BACKLOG.md, and sample-project/GIT_LOG.txt to TASK-001 reads, then show that `loom context --task TASK-001` exposes or unambiguously routes all three task-critical inputs.

gaps.gap: TASK-001 has no declared deliverable or reproducible proof path.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: The Task asks for a testable contract and executable acceptance cases, but touches is empty and the workspace contains no implementation/test scaffold or stated command. I cannot tell whether the intended result is a document, schema, fixtures, source module, or automated test, nor what command proves the Task done, without making an architectural choice that the Task was supposed to preserve across handoff.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Declare the concrete artifact path(s) and minimum form of the contract and acceptance cases, plus a deterministic command and expected result that demonstrates the cases pass. Record those paths in touches and the verification expectation in done_when or Task evidence guidance.

gaps.gap: The Work Map does not encode the sequence asserted by the project whole.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: PROJECT.md says the analysis core, interaction loop, and Windows validation follow the contract in order, yet TASK-002, TASK-003, and TASK-004 all have empty depends_on arrays. The map therefore treats downstream build and validation work as independently executable even though their outcomes rely on earlier artifacts.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Encode at least TASK-002 -> TASK-001, TASK-003 -> TASK-002, and TASK-004 -> TASK-003 dependencies, or document and encode a different intentional dependency graph whose tasks can genuinely be completed independently.

gaps.gap: Two candidate-input edge decisions remain outside the stated contract.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: The whole experience accepts a current role or today's goal, while TASK-001 only specifies a selected role. Also, the sample backlog has only two directly art-actionable items, but the product requires exactly three candidates and the dossier says main candidates should be broadly actionable while cross-role risk may be a reminder. There is no explicit fallback rule or exact art acceptance case for the third slot, so an implementer must either invent an action from Git context, promote a cross-role item, or violate the three-candidate promise.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Either include today's-goal handling in the contract acceptance cases or explicitly defer it from the vertical slice. Add a concrete art-role fixture expectation and a general insufficient-role-matches fallback policy that preserves provenance, the three-candidate requirement, and the distinction between actionable candidates and cross-role reminders.
